title: ToroFit: Fitting Wedge Sums of Tori to High-Dimensional Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.06990v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Data arising in scientific applications often exhibits complex nonlinear structure. Identifying and parameterizing said nonlinearities can enable better modeling, enhance predictive analysis, data interpolation, denoising, and anomaly detection. In this paper, we develop theoretical and computational methods to detect and parametrize Euclidean point cloud data lying near a wedge sum of tori. Specifically, we use persistent cohomology and cup products to identify the distinct toroidal components, and on each component, we optimize over low-energy multivariate trigonometric polynomials for best data fit. The ensuing optimization problem reduces to generalized ridge regression, which can be solved efficiently via standard techniques. translated_title: ToroFit：用环面的楔和拟合高维数据
translated_abstract: 科学应用中产生的数据往往呈现出复杂的非线性结构。识别并参数化这些非线性结构可以改进建模，增强预测分析、数据插值、去噪和异常检测能力。在本文中，我们开发了理论与计算方法，用于检测并参数化位于环面楔和附近的欧氏点云数据。具体而言，我们利用持续上同调和上积来识别不同的环面分量，并在每个分量上通过优化低能量多元三角多项式来获得最佳数据拟合。由此产生的优化问题可归结为广义岭回归，可借助标准技术高效求解。我们在合成数据集和真实数据集上展示了所提框架的实用性，包括低帧率循环视频的插值、准周期动力系统中吸引子的恢复等。
tldr: 本文提出ToroFit框架，利用持续上同调与上积识别高维点云数据中各环面结构分量，并通过将低能量多元三角多项式拟合归结为广义岭回归，实现对环面楔和型非线性数据的高效检测与参数化。
en_tdlr: ToroFit detects and parameterizes high-dimensional point cloud data lying near a wedge sum of tori by using persistent cohomology and cup products to identify toroidal components, and fitting low-energy multivariate trigonometric polynomials via an optimization problem that reduces to generalized ridge regression.
